mapper.select: SELECT l.*, COALESCE(c.name, s.name) AS partner_name, a.name AS account_name, st.settle_no, v.voucher_no, b.bill_no, u.nickname AS create_by_name FROM fin_note_log l LEFT JOIN scm_customer c ON l.action = 'RECEIVE' AND c.id = l.partner_id LEFT JOIN scm_supplier s ON l.action IN ('ENDORSE', 'ISSUE') AND s.id = l.partner_id LEFT JOIN fin_account a ON a.id = l.account_id LEFT JOIN fin_settlement st ON st.id = l.settlement_id LEFT JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.id = l.voucher_id LEFT JOIN fin_bill b ON b.id = l.bill_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = l.create_by WHERE l.note_id = #{noteId} ORDER BY l.id
